# apple_app_events (Data Source)

Lists an app's in-app events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_events" "published" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
  states = ["PUBLISHED"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `states` (Set of String) States to match: `DRAFT`, `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW`, `IN_REVIEW`, `REJECTED`, `ACCEPTED`, `APPROVED`, `PUBLISHED`, `PAST`, `ARCHIVED`. Values: `DRAFT`, `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW`, `IN_REVIEW`, `REJECTED`, `ACCEPTED`, `APPROVED`, `PUBLISHED`, `PAST`, `ARCHIVED`.

### Read-Only

- `app_events` (Attributes List) The in-app events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--app_events))

<a id="nestedatt--app_events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `app_events`

Read-Only:

- `badge` (String) Badge of the event.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app event.
- `reference_name` (String) Reference name of the event.
- `state` (String) State of the event.
